0fcd91d58b19: Editing a verse you already checked or aligned · translationCore 4 Help
c1ba7e1a0bf9: Checks and alignments are tied to the exact words of a verse, so when those words change tC4 marks what may no longer fit.
bab305fa9966: Change a verse in Translate that you already checked or aligned.
cf4ff9ae160d: Go to Check and open the checking tool. A notice at the top says how many decisions need review.
1ad836e88066: Click the Invalid filter to see those items, and decide each one again.
8adaab7c37c9: Open Align for the verse. Words you changed are back in the word bank. Place them and click ✓ Mark valid again.
9e7f896a239f: A check decision whose words changed becomes Invalid. It is kept, not deleted.
3d5c7795898c: In Align, links to the words you didn't change are kept. The verse shows as to do again.
c69cb0af2d36: A link stays on the word it was placed on, even if you add or remove words before it. If you delete a linked word, its link goes too.
52199ccf3ef4: If you change a word that comes more than once, and tC4 can't tell which copy you kept, the verse is flagged for review. Open it in Align, check the links, and click ✓ Mark valid again.
02c774e022a1: A verse that needs review shows a notice at the top of the verse in Align and is marked in the verse list.
223edf8f0d6d: Making or breaking a verse span has the same effect on those verses.
8c8ae7daabbf: A checking tool may reopen at the item you were on. Use the Invalid filter to find every item that needs review.
e395662b6ada: The notice at the top of a checking tool: 1 decision(s) no longer match the draft text and need re-review. Nothing was discarded.
